Improve the tracking when differentiating between air travel and other transport. Most of the time it recognises when you’re flying and displays the dashed line with the plane. It needs to be able to integrate with Airbnb and booking.com to actually book the stays instead of adding them afterwards. This is an obvious revenue booster. title: Polarsteps feedback
content:
I really like Polarsteps - a nice easy way to record your holiday and follow somebody else’s.    There are some things I would like to either know how to do - or would like to see in future updates.  
It has become very slow to load on the phone.  Even when completed there doesn’t seem to be a way of scrolling back and forth through photos of a location afterwards.
If you’re following a trip and you need to amend your comments afterwards the only way available is to delete them and start afresh.
Can you reorder photos once loaded.
It would be nice to be able to buy a book for someone else, not just a voucher.
Can you see how many pages a book has so you have an idea of the total cost?
Can you preview what you get for different prices before you commit to buying the book?
I’d like an easier way to switch between people when following their particular trips.
